summary: Independent review of Jinshu 086 (Zhang Gui / Zhang Shi) against the sealed Chinese units, not the English or prior model notes. Era-opening labels 永甯初, 永嘉初, and 建興初 are accepted as conventional first-year tags AD 301, 307, and 313; those years opened in the fourth, first, and fourth months and stay inside the same Western year. 永興中 is kept as the 304–306 era window for the Baneng raid. 泰始初 is correctly left unresolved with onOrAfter 265, because 泰始 opened in the twelfth month and 十二月丙寅 is already AD 266 on the Western tables. Undated sentences after 永嘉初 or 湣帝即位 keep one-sided onOrAfter 307 or 313 and do not invent a second endpoint. The 316 cluster is justified from 四載於茲 after 建興元年, plus 將降 / 自去年九月 / 逼遷天子; the chapter never writes 建興四年. Zhang Gui's death remains unresolved between inclusive 在州十三年 from 301 (=313) and the conventional Jianxing 2 / 314 reading, which this chapter does not write. 卒年六十 is kept as traditional-inclusive sui. Emperor Min is alive at 將降 (316) and already dead when 崩問 arrives before/with 太興 (318); that death stays bounded and unresolved. 漢末 anecdotes, ancestral names, and speech-precedents are not turned into Western life dates. Later 諡曰武公 and edict mentions are retrospective reception and do not feed active hints. Owned units were read for omitted birth, death, age, and date context: the named 卒/斬/自刎/嘔血而死 events are present; 沒於賊 is correctly not forced into a death year; no birth year is written. Context 318 rows for Zhang Shi, Zhang Lang, Han Pu, Chen An, Sima Bao, and Sima Rui cohere with the owned 316 events. No unsupported closed year was found.

references.title: 永兴 (西晋)
